listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ "Used to be" tuzog'i: Audioda spiker birinchi aytgan joyiga darhol aldanmang: "The gym used to be next to the library, but it was relocated near the cafeteria last month." 💡 Oltin qoida: Ko'pchilik "library" so'zini eshitiboq belgilab qo'yadi. Agar used to be, initially yoki previously so'zlarini eshitsangiz, bu 100% eski ma'lumot! Doim current / now / relocated to dan keyingi joyni kuting. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Raqamlar va narxlarda tuzoq: Spiker birinchi aytgan narxini deyarli har doim o'zgartiradi: "The tickets are £45... oh wait, that was last season's rate, they are £55 now." 💡 Oltin qoida: Birinchi raqamni yozib qo'ymang! Spiker "actually", "let me correct that" yoki "my mistake" deyishi bilan javob keyingi aytilgan raqamga o'zgaradi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Ikkitalik harflar spellingi (Double Letters): Section 1 da ko'pchilik ball yo'qotadigan eng makkor so'zlar: • accommodation (2 ta c, 2 ta m) • committee (2 ta m, 2 ta t, 2 ta e) • embarrassment (2 ta r, 2 ta s) 💡 Oltin qoida: Bitta harf xato bo'lsa ham butun savol nollanadi! Ushbu 10 ta so'zning yozilishini hoziroq daftaringizga yozib, spellingini tekshirib oling. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Ko'plik (-s) qo'shimchasi qopqoni: Audioda spiker "students" desa, siz "student" deb yozsangiz — javob xato hisoblanadi! 💡 Oltin qoida: Audioni eshitishdan oldin bo'shliq oldidagi artiklga qarang: • a / an bo'lsa ➡️ 100% birlikda bo'ladi. • Artikl bo'lmasa ➡️ ko'pincha ko'plikda (-s bilan) yoki sanalmaydigan ot bo'ladi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Xarita (Map) kompas yo'nalishlari: Spiker har doim ham left yoki right deyavermaydi. U ko'pincha kompas yo'nalishlarini ishlatadi: • due south = to'g'ri janubga • heading northbound = shimolga qarab harakatlanish • flanked on the west = g'arbiy tomondan o'ralgan 💡 Oltin qoida: Xarita berilishi bilan tepasidagi kompas ko'rsatkichiga (N, S, E, W) darhol qalam bilan qarab oling! 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

reading.text: 📖 IELTS READING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ False vs Not Given farqini topish: Ko'pchilik bu ikkalasini chalkashtirib ball yo'qotadi. 💡 Oddiy formula: • FALSE: Matnda savolga qarshi / teskari ma'lumot bor. Matn sizga savol noto'g'ri ekanini isbotlab beradi. • NOT GIVEN: Matn ham, siz ham savol to'g'ri yoki noto'g'riligini isbotlay olmaysiz. Matnda bu haqda gap ketmagan. Biror gapga shaxsiy taxmin qo'shmang — faqat matnga ishoning! 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

📖 IELTS READING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Matching Headings siri: Paragrafning faqat 1-jumlasi (Topic Sentence) ga qarab sarlavha tanlash ko'pincha adashtiradi! 💡 Oltin qoida: Spetsifik detallarga (misollar, yillar, foizlar) emas, paragrafning umumiy xulosasiga qarang. Agar paragraf o'rtasida However, But, In reality bo'lsa, asosiy fikr aynan o'sha burilishdan keyin keladi! 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

📖 IELTS READING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Ekstremal so'zlar qopqoni: True/False/Not Given savollarida quyidagi so'zlar kelsa, 90% holatda FALSE yoki NOT GIVEN bo'ladi: • always, never, solely, exclusively, must, impossible 💡 Oltin qoida: Matnda odatda yumshoqroq ifodalar keladi (often, likely, tends to). Agar savolda mutlaq chegaralash (always) bo'lsa, matndagi noziklikni tekshiring! 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

📖 IELTS READING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Summary Completion da grammatik filtr: Bo'shliqqa so'z qo'yishdan oldin matnni qidirib vaqt yo'qotmang. 💡 3 soniyalik formula: Avval bo'shliq o'rniga qaysi so'z turkumi tushishini aniqlang: • Ot (Noun)? Fe'l (Verb)? Sifat (Adjective)? • Agar oldida artikl bo'lsa, faqat birlikdagi ot mos keladi. Shunda 10 ta variantdan 7 tasi avtomatik o'chib ketadi! 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

📖 IELTS READING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Skimming va Scanning farqi: Ko'pchilik har bir so'zni bir xil tezlikda o'qib, vaqt yetkaza olmaydi. 💡 Oltin qoida: • Skimming (tez ko'z yugurtirish): Matnning umumiy mavzusi va paragraf nima haqida ekanini anglash uchun. • Scanning (ov qilish): Faqat aniq kalit so'zlar, yillar, ismlar va raqamlarni qidirish uchun. Butun gapni o'qimang, ko'zingiz bilan sakrab boring! 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

writing.text: ✍️ IELTS WRITING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ "Nowadays" deb boshlashni to'xtating: Imtihon oluvchi bu so'zni har kuni yuzlab marta o'qiydi va bu tayyor qolip deb baholanadi. 💡 Band 8.0+ almashtirish: ❌ Nowadays, many people believe that... ✅ In recent decades, an increasing number of individuals have argued that... Kichik o'zgarish butun insho darajasini akademik qilib ko'rsatadi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

✍️ IELTS WRITING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Inshoda fikrni chala qoldirish: Shunchaki fikrni aytib ketish ballni 6.0 da ushlab turadi. Har bir g'oyani PEEL qoidasi bilan kengaytiring: 💡 PEEL formulasi: 1. Point: Asosiy fikr 2. Explain: Nega shunday? Sababi 3. Example: Hayotiy yoki ilmiy dalil 4. Link: Xulosa va savolga bog'lash 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

✍️ IELTS WRITING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ "Every coin has two sides" klichyesi: Bu kabi maqol va idiomalarni inshoda ishlatish akademik uslubga mutlaqo to'g'ri kelmaydi. 💡 Band 8.0+ muqobil: ❌ Every coin has two sides, so there are advantages and disadvantages. ✅ While this phenomenon presents demonstrable benefits, several notable drawbacks warrant careful consideration. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

✍️ IELTS WRITING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Inshoda shaxsiy fikrni noo'rin takrorlash: Har bir gapni "In my opinion" yoki "I think" bilan boshlash uslubni qashshoqlashtiradi. 💡 Oltin qoida: Insho davomida faqat ob'yektiv, ilmiy tildan foydalaning: ❌ "I think that technology destroys communication." ✅ "It is widely argued that excessive reliance on digital devices undermines interpersonal communication." 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

✍️ IELTS WRITING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Conclusion (Xulosa) da yangi g'oya qo'shish: Ko'pchilik xulosada avval aytilmagan mutlaqo yangi argument qo'shib ball yo'qotadi. 💡 Oltin qoida: Conclusion — faqat inshoning qisqacha sintezi bo'lishi shart! Unda hech qanday yangi dalil yoki sabab keltirilmaydi. Asosiy fikringizni boshqa so'zlar bilan yakunlang. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Part 1 da 1 ta so'z bilan to'xtab qolish: Examiner: "Do you enjoy cooking?" ❌ "Yes, I like cooking very much." (Band 5.5) 💡 3 qadamli kengaytirish formulasi: 1. Javob: "To be perfectly honest, absolutely." 2. Sabab: "It serves as a fantastic therapeutic outlet for me..." 3. Misol: "...especially on weekends when I prepare traditional dishes." Har bir savolga kamida 2-3 jumlali javob bering! 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Part 2 da 1 daqiqalik tayyorgarlik vaqti: Ko'pchilik butun gaplarni yozishga harakat qilib vaqt yetkaza olmaydi. 💡 Oltin qoida: Gap yozmang! Faqat 4-5 ta Band 7+ kollokatsiya va kalit so'zlarni yozib oling (masalan: breathtaking scenery, once-in-a-lifetime experience). Gapirayotganda o'sha iboralarni ko'rib fikringiz ravon davom etadi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Part 3 da o'zingiz haqingizda gapirish: Examiner jamiyat, dunyo yoki insonlar haqida so'raganda "Menimcha men..." deb shaxsiy hayotga o'tib ketmang. 💡 Band 8.0+ yondashuv: Umumiy jamiyat nomidan javob bering: ❌ "I like online shopping because it saves my time." ✅ "From a broader societal perspective, digital commerce has revolutionised consumer behavior, offering unparalleled convenience." 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Noo'rin va noqulay sukunat (Awkward Pauses): Savol tushganda 3-4 soniya jim qolish yoki "Eeee... Aaa..." deyish ravonlik (Fluency) ballini keskin tushiradi. 💡 Natural Fillers dan foydalaning: O'ylash uchun vaqt yutishda shunday iboralarni ishlating: • "That's an intriguing question, let me consider that for a moment..." • "I've never really thought about that before, but I suppose..." 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Kichik grammatik xatoga qaytib to'xtab qolish: Bitta zamon yoki artiklni noto'g'ri aytib qo'ysangiz, to'xtab o'zingizni to'g'irlashga harakat qilmang. 💡 Oltin qoida: To'xtab gapni qayta aytish ravonlikni sindiradi va diqqatni aynan o'sha xatoga qaratadi. IELTSda ravonlik (Fluency) 100% grammatik mukammallikdan ko'ra muhimroq. To'xtamasdan oldinga davom eting! 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz
